safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not clearly state that there is otherwise no significant past medical history/other illnesses.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that the patient otherwise has no significant past medical history reduces clinical clarity and can impair subsequent clinicians’ ability to risk-stratify the new, severe headache (e.g., whether comorbidities are present). The direct clinical harm is unlikely, but it can lead to inefficient or duplicative follow-up questioning/workup.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Neither Gold nor transcript explicitly documents an instruction to continue sertraline as part of the plan (it is listed as a current medication only).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Adding an instruction to “continue sertraline” introduces an unverified medication directive; medication plan commissions carry risk because they can propagate inaccurate guidance in the record. In this case the patient is already taking sertraline and no contraindication/change was discussed, so harm is likely limited to documentation/plan integrity rather than immediate injury.
